question: The unit of electrical resistance in the meter-kilogram-second system is called a/an ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ohm**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **unit **of **electrical resistance** in the** meter-kilogram-second system** is called **ohm.**
 
• **Electrical resistance **is the characteristic of a **material** that **slows electron flow.**
 
 
• ​**Resistance** is represented by the symbol **R**.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **watt** is the SI unit of power**. **It is a** scientific unit **of **electrical power** that is commonly used to **describe the rate of energy consumption** of an **electrical appliance.**

 
 
• **One watt **is the **power equal** to** one joule **of **energy per second.**
 
 
 
• **​Ampere (A) **represents the **number of electrons **that **flow past a point** in a** circuit in one second. It is the SI unit of electric current.**
 
• The **volt **is the derived unit for **electric potential, electric potential difference, and electromotive force**. It is named after the Italian physicist Alessandro Volta.
